gloss: to polish up; to refine; to perfect

definitions.gloss: to polish up; to make shine
definitions.explanation: to polish something thoroughly until it shines

definitions.gloss: to refine; to perfect; to hone
definitions.explanation: to improve skills, techniques, or qualities to a high level through effort

examples.japanese: {床|ゆか}を{磨|みが}き{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I polished the floor until it shone.

examples.japanese: {靴|くつ}を{磨|みが}き{上|あ}げる。
examples.english: To polish shoes to a shine.

examples.japanese: ピカピカに{磨|みが}き{上|あ}げられた{車|くるま}。
examples.english: A car polished to a sparkling finish.

examples.japanese: {技|わざ}を{磨|みが}き{上|あ}げる。
{長年|ながねん}かけて{磨|みが}き{上|あ}げた{話術|わじゅつ}。
examples.english: Speaking skills refined over many years.

examples.japanese: {感性|かんせい}を{磨|みが}き{上|あ}げる。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})

COMPOUND VERB:
{磨|みが}く (to polish/brush) + {上|あ}げる (to finish/complete)
The {上|あ}げる adds completion or bringing to perfection.

SENSE 1 (Physical):
- {床|ゆか}/{窓|まど}/{靴|くつ}を{磨|みが}き{上|あ}げる
- Often results in something shiny (ピカピカ)

SENSE 2 (Figurative):
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}/{腕|うで}/{才能|さいのう}を{磨|みが}き{上|あ}げる
- Used for skills, abilities, artistic qualities

RELATED:
- {磨|みが}く (to polish, to brush)
- {鍛|きた}え{上|あ}げる (to train thoroughly)
- {仕上|しあ}げる (to finish, to complete)
